about_the_game:
(Note: Game is still very early in development and does not yet show case all features, maps, and mechanics available in the final build.)

Matter of Factory brings a whole new Local PvP experience! Battle with your friends in the fight to build, sabotage, and survive!

"Work like your life depends on it, cuz it does..."

Welcome to the factories... Build toys and break friendships in 1v1 or 2v2 game modes within the ULTIMATE party game. Play with your friends, or in online ranked battles to complete more orders, and make more money. With multiple different maps, events, and special mechanics, no two matches are the same.

STEAL

Steal materials from your opponents in order to complete blueprints. With multiple changing ways to get your materials, learn to adapt and strategize to use what you need and steal what you don't.

BUILD

Assemble parts at your workbench to build blueprints, and complete orders. Collect, combine, and paint, to create a multitude of different toys.

SABOTAGE

Sabotage your opponents in exciting ways to get the upper hand... Cause a super slick blizzard, Scramble their movement, or maybe even blow up their hard work. Grab tokens before the opposition, and spin the Sabaslot to get a lucky sabotage. Strategically activate for maximum effect by pressing the forbidden "Big Red Button".

SURVIVE

Your opponent won't be the only one sabotaging you on the factory floor... Random events will constantly keep everyone on their toes. From raging fires, to raining eggs and menacing chickens, if you can't adapt and overcome, the factory will.

COLLECT

Customize by collecting, hats, skins, trails, and even pets! Dominate the factory in online ranked mode, or earn achievements while playing Party Mode with your friends and complete daily missions for a chance at winning the super fresh prizes!
